comment: Owner exceptions to decision D3 (2026-11-04). import.mjs applies them before the D3 order: zero_compounds first (no pair is written), then overrides.

zero_compounds.name: Hydrogen
zero_compounds.reason: Every hydrogen pair is zero (no pair written): the DECHEMA H2 values are narrow-range fits (H2/Toluene -0.51, H2/N-butane -0.397, H2/Propane -0.131) that would put H2 into the oil; zero is DWSIM's own default without data and the treatment H2 gets with the crude fractions.

overrides.source: Owner exception to D3: ChemSep 2009 PR table pr.ipd, "Methane/Hydrogen Sulfide T=40,100,160 F, Reamer et al data, fit by R.Taylor" (Kooijman and Taylor, Artistic License 2.0). kij_pr.dat's 0.1356 equals the DECHEMA Methane/SulfurDioxide value (pr_ip.dat line 115) and is taken as a transcription error.
